units.function: Database-backed operational state coordinator for simulated local-stdio runtime slots, including deployment gating, capacity, idle cleanup, stuck recovery, restart backoff/storm suppression, bounded logs and management views.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends directly on Paperclip Tool runtime/audit tables, activity logging, deployment enums, process environment/PID and caller-supplied execution callbacks. Tool Gateway depends on it; actual subprocess execution remains elsewhere.
units.keyDataModels: ToolRuntimeSlot with company/application/connection identity, slot/reuse key, runtime kind/status, provider reference, health, idle deadlines and mutable metadata containing host, process, resource, restart, counter and log projections.
units.lifecycle: Finds or creates a connection slot, checks deployment and capacity, marks it running, lends a mutable handle to a callback, records idle/failure state, lazily stops expired slots, detects stale progress, applies restart controls and exposes stop/restart/list operations.
units.testAssessment: Runtime scenarios in the already-read Tool Gateway acceptance suite cover sequential lazy start/reuse/idle reap, host capacity, public-host fail-closed behavior, explicit control, restart storms and stuck recovery. Local execution skipped the embedded-PostgreSQL tests. Missing are concurrent creation/use/stop/restart, atomic capacity reservation, real process death/resource enforcement, fencing, caller metadata spoofing, error Secret leakage, log-write races, multi-host cleanup ownership and audit failure recovery.
units.designRationale: Make local stdio execution operationally observable and controllable while preventing it in untrusted public deployments and providing basic capacity/recovery behavior without a separate scheduler.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a real customer-local execution node with short-lived secret-free attestation, exclusive fenced leases, bounded resources, cancellation and durable effect/evidence semantics across managed-cloud and self-hosted profiles.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the public-deployment fail-closed gate, separate company/host quotas, idle TTL, exponential restart backoff, storm suppression, stuck recovery states, bounded logs and structured reason codes. Implement them in an independent ExecutionNode/RuntimeLease boundary with database-atomic reservations, host attestation, CAS/fencing, real process/container controls, Secret-safe structured errors and transactional event outbox.
units.responsibilityConflict: The supervisor represents a simulated process with no spawned PID or enforced memory ceiling, accepts caller overrides of supervisor metadata, allows concurrent unfenced use and stale lifecycle overwrites, and writes state/audits nontransactionally. Errors are durably stored and audited without Secret redaction. Events bind only Agent/system, not accountable human, ResponsibilityContract, execution-node proof or data authorization.
